bindings.variant: measure (CTC-first, geometric only on CTC miss)

findings: Sequential CTC-first holds at 500 rows for ranking, and the 50-row check overstated overall fused quality. Same shard-1 IDs as grapheneos-measure-swipe-500-1: fused_swipe 78.2%/84.0% vs CTC 84.6%/92.0% (was fused 47.0%/50.8% pre-fusion). fused_relaxed 86.6%/93.0%. 0 empty fused slates.

When the fused path has CTC candidates (373/500), fused top-1 is 85.5% vs CTC 83.4% and top-1 surfaces agree on 92.2%. Ranking is not the deficit. The 127 CTC-empty fused slates are the gap: geometric ran on 114 of them; 42 of 46 CTC-hit/fused-miss rows are in this set. Standalone CTC on those same rows is p50 89 ms and >200 ms on only 4/127, so the production 200 ms slot is emptying CTC, not the model.

The 50-row sequential check (86%/90% fused) was the same first 50 IDs but a warmer decode (3 CTC-empty, geometric on 1/50). In this 500-row run those 50 scored fused 60%/66% with 33 CTC-empty. Quintiles recover: last 200 rows fused 85.5%/92.5% vs CTC 84.5%/92.5%, decode p50 162–166 ms, 5 CTC-empty.

fused_swipe p50/p95 185.9/233.8 ms. 183/500 over 200 ms. The 210–220 ms wait-out-budget mode is gone (8 rows); 125 rows sit in 200–210 ms with decode p50 200.4 ms. Stage split: decode p50/p95 174.7/216.2 ms, fusion 7.3/55.5 ms, next-word ~0. Remaining p95 over 200 ms is CTC through LiveSwipeModelSlot plus occasional 50 ms neural, then a 15 ms geometric grace on CTC-empty.
limitations: Diagnostic only. The measure APK is not the pinned debugNoMinify APK 8b8eb864… used by stock-hw-shard0-1 and grapheneos-hw-shard1-1, so these rows cannot enter the Phase 0 matrix as-is.
500 rows of shard 1/3, not a full shard. Each measured row also runs standalone geometric (1500 ms) and standalone CTC before fused_swipe, so fused decode here is heavier than a production swipe.
releaseEligible is false. Pooled matrix evaluation still needs the low-RAM environment.
scope: Diagnostic 500-row GrapheneOS check that sequential CTC-first tracks CTC at shard-slice scale. Not a Phase 0 matrix replacement.
